program_name: Online Bachelor of International Public Health

programme_facts.value: Are you interested in addressing global challenges and making a meaningful impact in health and health care? Develop the innovative mindset needed to help tackle the complex public health issues that affect local and international communities.

programme_facts.value: Arizona State University’s online Bachelor of International Public Health equips you to meet the challenges faced in health care around the globe. In this program, you’ll dive into topics ranging from health promotion and communicable disease prevention to environmental health and public health surveillance.
